parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kitchen pot, typically made of stainless steel. It is circular and fits snugly on top of the pot to cover it.
parts.Functional_description: The lid helps retain heat and moisture during cooking, preventing spills and speeding up the cooking process.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the pot. It is detachable and not fixed to the main body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kitchen pot, made of stainless steel. It has a rounded shape with a handle and spout for pouring.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the food or liquid being cooked. It distributes heat evenly and provides structural support for the lid.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary during use but can be lifted or tilted by the handle for pouring or cleaning.
